gloss: make (someone) do; let (someone) do (causative, godan verbs)

definitions.gloss: to make someone do; to force someone to do
definitions.explanation: The causative auxiliary for godan verbs. It attaches to the nai-stem, the あ-row form: {書|か}く → {書|か}かせる, {行|い}く → {行|い}かせる, {待|ま}つ → {待|ま}たせる, and verbs in う take わ: {買|か}う → {買|か}わせる. Ichidan verbs, する and {来|く}る take させる instead.

definitions.gloss: to let someone do; to allow
definitions.explanation: The same form when the person is allowed or helped to act as they wish: {子|こ}どもを{自由|じゆう}に{遊|あそ}ばせる (let the children play freely). With ください or もらう it asks permission: {言|い}わせてください (let me say something).

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}かせた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I made the child write a letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{待|ま}たせて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I kept my friend waiting for a whole hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧⟦{読|よ}ませた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: The teacher made the students who forgot their homework read the textbook three times.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦{言|い}わせて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}かせた→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We let our son go and study abroad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧くらい⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ばせて→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧あげたい。
examples.english: At least on weekends, I want to let the children play as much as they like.

notes:
FORMS:
The result is an ichidan verb: ⟦{書|か}か→書く：00477_kaku⟧せる, ⟦{書|か}かせない→書く：00477_kaku⟧, ⟦{書|か}かせた→書く：00477_kaku⟧, ⟦{書|か}かせて→書く：00477_kaku⟧. In speech a short form ending in 〜す is common ({書|か}かす, {待|ま}たす), and some verbs have a separate transitive verb that does the same job ({泣|な}かす beside ⟦{泣|な}か→泣く：00655_naku⟧せる).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧C⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧〜せる: A makes or lets B do C (⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}わせた→洗う：00827_arau⟧, I made my brother wash the dishes)
- A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧〜せる: with an intransitive verb ({子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}ら→走る：00519_hashiru⟧せる, to make the child run)
- 〜⟦せられる→する：00392_suru⟧ / 〜⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: causative passive, to be made to do (⟦{待|ま}たせられる→待つ：00469_matsu⟧, colloquially {待|ま}たされる)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{待|ま}た→待つ：00469_matsu⟧せる almost always means to keep someone waiting, as in ⟦お{待|ま}たせ→お待たせ：27262_omatase⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ (sorry to have kept you waiting); "let someone wait" is possible only when the context makes the permissive sense clear.
